description: Source code for the MidiManagerUsb class handling USB MIDI device management, data transmission, device enumeration, and port management within the midi namespace.

classes.name: MidiManagerUsb
classes.description: Manages USB MIDI devices, handles device enumeration, data transmission, and port state management.

methods.name: MidiManagerUsb
methods.description: Constructor initializing the MIDI manager with a service and device factory.

methods.name: ~MidiManagerUsb
methods.description: Destructor performing cleanup and unbinding tasks.

methods.name: StartInitialization
methods.description: Begins the initialization process, binding to task service.

methods.name: DispatchSendMidiData
methods.description: Sends MIDI data to a specified port with a timestamp delay.

methods.name: ReceiveUsbMidiData
methods.description: Handles incoming USB MIDI data from a device.

methods.name: OnDeviceAttached
methods.description: Handles new device attachment, adds ports.

methods.name: OnDeviceDetached
methods.description: Handles device removal, updates port states.

methods.name: OnReceivedData
methods.description: Processes received MIDI data from a specific jack.

methods.name: OnEnumerateDevicesDone
methods.description: Callback after device enumeration completes, initializes input stream and ports.

methods.name: AddPorts
methods.description: Parses device descriptors, adds input/output ports accordingly.
